input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications (19.1); Deliverables are warranted for ninety days from the later of delivery or acceptance and hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2), which is at least as protective as the preferred 12-month software / 90-day services benchmark. Section 19.3 adds no-malicious-code, Applicable Law compliance, no functionality diminution and open-source protection. Section 19.4 provides the full remedy ladder — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then terminate-and-refund of Fees paid — and expressly preserves non-exclusivity for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline required.
